WITH top5_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 THEN f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
            ELSE 0 
        END AS frpm_rate
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.SOC = '66' 
        AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL 
        AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT frpm_rate FROM top5_schools;
